tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bslab gsum rnam gzhag la sogs pa bzhugs so//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ rin po che lha rje'i zhal nas/ bslab pa rnam pa gsum ni/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa dang*/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa'o// tshul khrims gang zhe na/ mkhan po dang slob dpon las so sor thar pa'i sdom pa blangs nas/ ji lta ba bzhin bsrung ba ni so thar/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas bslab bya la slob pa ni/ byang sems/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims de nas/ gsang sngags kyi dbang bskur zhus nas/ dam tshig ji lta ba bzhin bsrung ba ni/ gsang sngags/ sdom pa'i tshul khrims/ gang zag gcig gi rgyud la sdom pa gsum rten 'brel skor gcig tu gnas dgos te/ gnas na ji ltar gnas/ bsrung na ji ltar bsrung*/ ldan na ji ltar ldan/ 'chos na ji ltar 'chos pa'o// de yang*/ gnas na bye brag tu gnas te/ bye brag gang zhe na/ mkhan po'am slob dpon las sdom pa blangs pa'i dus su/ ngas so sor thar (2na)pa'i sdom pa thob snyam/ sems bskyed pa'i dus su/ ngas sems bskyed thob byang chub sems dpa' yin snyam/ dbang bskur ba'i dus su/ ngas sngags sdom thob pas rig pa 'dzin pa yin snyam/ de ltar snyam tsam las/ ngo bo gcig la so sor ni yod pa ma yin no// bsrung na 'chol bar bsrung*/ 'chol pa gang zhe na/ so sor thar pa'i dus su 'dul ba bzhin bsrung*/ sems bskyed nas byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bya/ dbang bskur nas gsang sngags kyi dam tshig bsrung*/ ldan na yar ldan te/ thug 'dom byung ba'i dus su/ rim gyis gong ma gtso cher bya'o// 'chos na grub mthas 'chos te/ so thar la skyon byung na/ mkhan po la sogs pa la bshags pas chog na bshags/ bskyar dgos na bskyar/ byang chub sems dpa'i dus su skyon byung na/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la bshags pas chog na bshags/ bsdam par 'os na bsdam/ (2ba)gsang sngags kyi ltung ba byung na/

bla ma la bshags pas chog na bshags/ bskyar dgos na bskyar ro// de ni lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'o// lhag pa sems kyi bslab pa ni/ sdom pa rnams la bsngo bgrang byed cing*/ rang gi sems nyid glang po che smyon pa lta bu de/ lhag pa tshul khrims kyi dmigs pa'i ka ba la/ dran pa'i zhags thag gis dam du bcings/ shes rab kyi lcags kyus bzung nas/ blo rim gyis sgom pa ni zhi gnas so// de ltar zhi gnas kyis sems rtse gcig tu bzhag nas/ lhag mthong gi spyod pa zhig byed de/ sdom pa la rtog dpyod btang bas/ ji srid rtog dpyod 'dug phan chad bsam shes la/ rtog dpyod las 'das nas bsgom shes/ lhag pa shes rab kyi bslab pa ni/ chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin spros pa thams cad dang bral ba de go zhing rtogs pa'o// de ni bslab pa rnam pa gsum mo/// /na mo gu ru/ shes rab rnam pa gnyis ni/ don dam pa'i shes rab dang*/ kun rdzob kyi shes rab bo// don dam pa ni gnyug ma'o// kun rdzob ni chos rnams la rnam par 'byed pa'o// de la gsum ste/ rgyu dang*/ ngo bo dang*/ gegs so// rgyu thos bsam/ ngo bo skye med/ gegs thos bsam mi byed pa'o// bdag med pa rnam pa gnyis ni/ gang zag gi bdag med pa dang*/ chos kyi bdag med do// de la nyan thos pa rang gi phung po dang*/ khams dang*/ skye mched rnams gang zag gi bdag tu 'dod de/ rgyu nyon mongs pas gang la/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung por zag pas na gang zag go /chos kyi bdag ni/ phyi gzung ba'i yul lo// ma dpe kha cig na/ chos kyi bdag nyid nyon mongs pa'i tshogs yod ma myong ba'i phyir/ theg pa chen po ni bdag dang zhes bya ba snang*/ theg pa chen po pa ni gang zag (3na)gi bdag khams gsum snang grags kyi chos la bya/ chos ni nang 'dzin pa'i sems la bya'o// 'o dod rnam pa gsum ni/ snyan pa'i 'o dod/ bde ba'i 'o dod/ grags pa'i 'o dod/

snyan pa'i 'o dod ni/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes 'gro ba thams cad kyi rgyud la yod pa'i gnyug ma/ de rang la yod pas gzhan nas btsal mi dgos so// bde ba'i 'o dod ni/ sdug bsngal spangs pa'i bde ba chen po chos kyi sku de/ rang gi sems rig pa chos kyi sku 'di kho na yin/ logs na med pas btsal mi dgos so// grags pa'i 'o dod ni/ snang grags kyi chos 'di dag thams cad rang gi sems yin/ logs nas ma byung khyod de la 'jigs mi dgos so// smyo ba dang ma smyo ba'i khyad par ni/ tshe 'di 'ba' zhig don du gnyer ba rnams ni smyo ba'o// mi dge ba bcu spangs nas/ dge ba bcu dang du len pa rnams ni ma smyo ba'o// mkhas mi mkhas kyi khyad par ni/ ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal gyis 'jigs nas/ de'i skyabs su sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig shes te/ 'bras bu lha mi thob par 'dod pa ni mi mkhas pa yin/ spyir 'khor ba'i mtshan nyid shes nas/ sems can gyi don du mya ngan las 'das pa thob par 'dod pa ni mkhas pa yin/ rgyu tshul khrims rnam par dag pa/ mtshan nyid dmigs pa rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ nyams bde ba mi rtog pa/ rnam rtog nye bar zhi ba/ 'bras bu mi rtog pa shas che ba/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi'o// gsal ba shas che na/ gzugs khams/ bde ba shas che na/ 'dod khams so// rgyu thos bsam gyi shes rab/ mtshan nyid sems rnam par dag pa/ nyams gsal ba mi rtog pa/ 'bras bu chos sku zung du 'brel na nyams de yo (3ba)'char ro// nyams bde gsal mi rtog pa yin/ rtogs pa ni/ sems skye 'jig rang bral bar go ba de yin/ de ltar nges kyang*/ sems bde bde po'am/ gsal gsal po gnas gnas po cig 'dod na/ rtogs pa nyams su shor ba yin/ nyams myong byung ba'i dus su/ rtogs pa 'di rang yin/ 'di las lhag pa med snyam nas/ de la don dam du 'dzin na/ nyams rtogs par shor ba yin/ rtogs pa med na nyams myong des mtho ris kyi rgyu las mi 'ong*/

nyams kyi zhe 'dod byung yang rtsa ba chod na/ rtogs pa des lam sna zin/ nyams byung yang rtogs pa med/ rtogs pa byung na nyams myong mi 'byung mi srid/ rtogs pa ni/ sems rig pa'i ngo bo 'di lhag ge mthong ba'i dus su/ 'di yin gsungs pa la/ 'di dang po nas ngo shes thang ba cig 'dug pa la snyam pa 'ong*/ de la/ nyams bde ba ni/ zag pa med pa rang bzhin gyi bde ba chen po'o// gsal ba ni/ kha na tson ne 'ong snyam byed pa'o// spar mos bcang du 'dod pa snyam byed pa 'ong*/ mi rtog pa ni/ rtog pa phra mos kyang mi gos pa'o// de nyams rtogs gnyis med du shar ba yin/ gnas pa'i nyams ni/ thabs lam bcun pas/ rlung dhū tir tshud pa'i stobs kyis bde ba ni/ zag bcas kyi bde bas lus sems rgyas pa gsal ba ni/ de nyams su myong ba yin/ mi rtog pa ni/ rtog med kyi ting nge 'dzin dran pa med pa phyam phyam pa 'ong*/ de ni rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba yin gsung ngo*// bla ma lha rje rin po che'i gsung sgros/ slob dpon sgom tshul dang*/ sgom chung gnyis la gdams pa/ des stod lung gi spyan snga'i slob dpon pho ro ba la gdams pa'o// //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// (4na)dge bshes lcags ri ba la/ bka' gdams pa rtog pa mi spong bar lam du 'khyer ba'i gdams pa bdog gam zhus pas/ dge bshes glang ri thang pas/ chos dge bshes phu chung pa la zhus pas/ so tham pa cig mdzad nas/ yod pa yod de nga la bzlas dbang med pa/ 'ban chos pa byung zer 'ong gsung skad/ phyis rnal 'byor pa gnyis la gdams ngag bdog gam zhus pas/ byung gsung*/ de gnyis kyis jo bo rje la yang slob/ lo ts+tsha ba rin chen bzang po dang*/ sgom chen spun gnyis kyis sras lags skad/ dbus su lcags ri ba/ de smin par mdzad gsung*/ gdams ngag ji ltar zhus na/ rtogs pa'i rgyu med de gzhi rtsa ma grub pas/ rtogs pa'i thabs la mkhas te/ bka' rtags kyi phyag rgya dang 'dra/

rgyal po'i bka' rtags yod pa de bskur bas/ jag pa dang 'phrad kyang rtags de yod pas mi 'jigs kyi steng du grogs byed/ de bzhin du/ gsang sngags kyi thabs kyi nyon mongs pas mi gnod kyi steng du lam du 'char ba ltar rtogs pa'i thabs dang ldan pas/ kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos dang*/ rnam par byang ba'i chos thams cad ngo shes pas spang blang med/ spang blang med pas re dwogs med/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rtog par 'dug /rtog pa sems su shes nas/ sems skye ba med pa chos sku ru ngo shes pas 'bras bu la re ba med de/ sku gsum rang la yod pa'i phyir/ 'khor ba la dogs pa med de/ spang du med cing shes rab kyi bud shing yin pa'i phyir/ gang yang spang bya ma yin pas spang bya ni med gsung*/ sgom chen pas sgom pa'i dus su rtog pa 'byung ste/ de la phrad 'joms pa dang*/ phyi bsnyags pa dang*/ me sprul lo// de la (4ba)phrad 'joms pa ni/ rnam rtog byung ma thag tu skye med du chod nas/ rang sems ngo shes pa de yin gsung*/ phrad ma 'joms na/ phyi bsnyag pa ni/ rnam rtog de gang nas byung na/ sems las byung*/ sems la thim/ sems dang tha mi dad par bsam pa de yin gsung*/ mdo sprul pa ni/ gang shes pa la lci ba de yid la mi bde bar 'dzin na/ shin tu lci ba cig sprul pa yin te/ 'o skol rab tu byung ba la/ rtsa ba bzhi la nyes skyon med bzhin du mis bskur ba btab na/ shes pa la lci/ yid la de mi bde ba yin te/ de rnam par rtog pa/ rnam par rtog pa de sems/ sems de skye med yin gsung*/ de la dpe rnam pa gsum/ dang po/ nags la me shor ba dang 'dra ste/ nags la me shor tsa na rlung nyid grogs su 'gro /rtsi shing nags tshal nas/ sa rdo tshun chad kyang grogs su 'gro ste/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/ shing thams cad gros byas nas/ me la dmag drangs pas/ me na re/ khyed ji ltar mang ba ltar nga'i 'dod yin bya ba/

sher phyin na bzhugs skad/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog ji ltar mang ba ltar shes rab kyi grogs su 'gro /gnyis pa/ chu la kha ba bab pa dang 'dra ste/ bab ma thag nas chur ro gcig par 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ rnam rtog byung ma thag nas lhan cig skyes par ro gcig go /gsum pa/ sngar 'dris pa'i mi dang phrad pa 'dra ste/ sngar 'dris kyi mi dang phrad tsa na// yin min gyi rtog dpyod bgyi mi 'tshal// de bzhin du/ rnam rtog la rtog dpyod bgyi mi 'tshal bar skye med du ngo shes gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ rtog pa nyid lam du khyer na spangs pas ci la spongs gsung skad do// rnam rtog lam 'khyer yin te/ bla ma'i (5na)dang cung mi 'dra gsung*/ stong nyid ra mdar ldog zhang en tsam cig yod gsung*/ rtog pa'i rgyu med bya ba'am/ shes rab kyi bud shing min bya ba la sogs pa gsungs pas so// lcags ri ba'i gdams ngag yin gsung*/ kha cig thabs gtso cher 'chad/ kha cig shes rab gtso cher 'chad de/ blo dman pa'i dus su thabs gtso che ba man ngag yin gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ blo yar song tsa na/ shes rab gtso cher rang shugs kyis 'gro ba yin gsung*/ da yong nga la mi dgos snyam na/ dgos bdo ba yin gsung*/ shugs 'byung gis 'gags pa cig dgos pa yin/ shugs 'byung bya ba'i go ba ni/ bcos ma dang bral ba zhig yin gsung ngo*// sgom chen pa rnams la zhu ba/ gnas pa'i dus su rtog med de rgyun bsring ba yin te/ ngo bo la rtog med rgyun bsrings na chos kyi gnad ma go ba yin/ chos ma chod pa yin gsung ngo*// gdod ma nas rgyun chad ma myong ba'i gnad kas gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ stong nyid kyi spyi'i gol sa bzhi yin/ stong nyid shes bya'i gshis la shor ba bya ba/ chos thams cad nam mkha' ltar ci yang ma grub zer ba de yin te/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i sgom lugs yin/ blos byas kyi stong nyid bya ba yin te/

rdzogs chen pa la nye ba yin gsung*/ rgyas 'debs ni sngags kyi lugs yin te/ rgyu la 'bras bu'i rgyas 'debs shing*/ 'bras bu la yang rgyus rgyas 'debs zhes zer zhing*/ de yang stong pa yin zer nas/ thams cad blos byas kyi stong pas rgyas 'debs pa de yin te/ stong nyid rgyas 'debs la shor ba ni tsher ma la dar gyis g.yog pa dang 'dra gsung*/ stong nyid gnyen por shor ba ni/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa (5ba)thams cad stong par bsgyur nas/ stong nyid la nyon mongs pa'i gnyen po yong ma myong gsung*/ stong pa nyid lam du shor ba bya ba ni/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ stong nyid de lam ma yin/ 'bras bu yin gsung*/ gzhir bshad kyang don la shes bya'i gshis shes bya ba/ blos byas kyi stong pa de yin gsung*/ zhen pa dang bral ba la des kyang phan du rung gsung*/ rab kyis nyan thos kyi byang chub 'ong srid/ 'bring gis bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi tsam 'byung*/ tha mas tshe 'di la na tsha zhi tsam 'byung gsungs/ don dam pa 'di 'dra ma cig yin bya ba sangs rgyas kyis kyang gsung bar ma nus/ rgyun chad med pa de sangs rgyas kyi bkag kyang mi khegs/ sangs rgyas kyis gzigs par yang mi 'gyur gsung*/ rin po che'i zhal nas/ bka' gdams pa yang lta ba la rtsis che/ grub mtha'i lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ lta bas bltas pas stong par mthong ba rtsis che gsung*/ bla ma yang grub mtha'i lta ba 'di ltar lags zer ba la rtsis mi che/ spyir chos thams cad nyams thog nas myong ba cig dgos gsung ngo*// stong nyid shes bya'i gshis sgom pa dang*/ rtsa rlung bsgoms pa'i rten 'brel gyis nyams 'byung ba de yang nyams yin te/ des chos sha rus chod pa mi mchi gsung*/ chos sha rus chod pa la/ don dam skyes pa'i nyams shig dgos/ kun rdzob sgyur mar mthong bar bya ba dang*/ sems nyid sgyu mar mthong ba bya ba gnyis yin te/ sems nyid sgyu mar mthong na/

de ni yod pa yang ma yin/ med pa yang ma yin/ bkag pas mi khegs/ blo'i yul du byar mi btub/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis kyang mi gzigs na/ rnam rtog gi blos mi mthong gsung ngo*// rin po che'i zhal nas/ rnam par (6na)rtog pa ni dgos pa sku drin can yin te/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas/ yon tan thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod pa yin gsung*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni/ bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas 'od gsal gyi rtsal sbyong ba yin gsung ngo*// gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa las log nas kyang*/ bskyed rim la brten nas rtsal sbyong ba yin gsung ngo*// sgom chen pa rnam par rtog pa la skyon du mi blta rtog pa la dbang thob pa zhig dgos gsung ngo*// sgom chen pa de la na ba dag 'ong ngam zhe na/ lus 'byung ba bzhi la grub pas/ na ba 'ong ste/ byung ma thag tu na ba rnam rtog yin par shes/ rnam rtog sems su shes/ sems skye med chos skur shes pa zhig 'ong*/ skyes pa yin pa'i nad kas 'chi ba 'ong ste/ 'chi ba yang gong ltar shes pa zhig 'ong*/ gal te dmyal ba'i snang ba lta bur shar yang*/ gong ltar shes pa zhig 'ong ste/ slob dpon tog tse pa'i zhal nas/ nga ni shes pa 'di go nas// dmyal ba dag tu skyes srid kyang*// dmyal ba nyid kyang bde bar 'char// zhes gsung ngo*// bla ma'i zhal nas/ rnam rtog sku drin che ba ci ste zhe na/ de sems las byung ba yin/ sems chos sku yin/ rnam rtog de ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin te/ rtog pa de ni ngo bo gsal bar byed pas sgron me lta bu yin/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba gcod par byed pas mtshon lta bu yin/ rtog pa lam du khyer bas/ rtog med 'char ba ngo mtshar re che gsung*/ rtog pa de rgyu yin nam/ lam yin nam/ 'bras bu yin nam ji ltar yin zhe na/ rgyu yin te/ kho rang la brten nas yon tan thams (6ba)cad 'byung*/

lam yang yin te/ de nyid mi spong bar lam du 'khyer/ 'bras bu yang yin te/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas/ sku bzhi rang chas su yod pas/ 'bras bu gzhan nas mi re/ rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum gcig tu 'khyer ba gdams ngag bya ba yin gsung ngo*// rang cag la 'khris gnyis yod de/ phyi'i 'khris dang*/ nang gi 'khris gnyis yin/ phyi'i 'khris ni/ ci yang ma grub pa cig yin pa la/ bdag dang khams gsum po 'di la dngos po dang mtshan mar bzung*/ nang gi 'khris ni/ bde ba dang gsal ba la yon tan du bltas pas/ 'jig rten pa'i lam du song*/ 'o na ci ltar byas pas 'khris med par 'gyur snyam na/ bla ma dang rgyud 'dres pa cig dgos gsung*/ dus rtag tu bla ma yid la byas na/ byin rlabs rgyun chad med par 'gyur/ snang zhing srid pa'i chos thams cad chos skur shes par bya zhing gnyis 'dzin spang*/ rang sems bla mar shes par bya zhing*/ sems can la gnod pa'i las mi bya/ bdag dang khams gsum po thams cad sems kyi ngo bo gcig tu byas te/ rgya'am stong tsam du byed par 'chi res byed la zhes gsung*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa gsum sems kyi ngo bo yin pas/ spyod lam rnam bzhir ma yengs par bya/ de gsum ngo bo gcig tu shes par bya/ zhi gnas lhag mthong rtogs par 'dod na/ bka' gdams pa ltar lhan cig tu spungs pas kyang mi 'ong*/ rnal 'byor pa ltar grong khrod 'grims pas kyang mi 'ong gsung ngo*// rin po che'i zhal nas/ rang cag la 'khris med pa zhig dgos te/ chos brgyad kyi 'khris kyang yod pa des kyang mi 'ong ste/ chos brgyad du song na/ dge (7na)bshes yon bdag gi zhal nas/ nag po'i bstan pa bya ba yin gsung*/ thar pa'i rgyur dag ci la yang 'gro ste/ mtho ris kyi rgyur yang mi 'gro gsung*/ dge bshes sgre pa'i zhal nas/ chos ma yin pa chos ltar bcos pa bya ba yin gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen glang ri thang pa'i zhal nas/

mi dge ba rang yin gsung*/ 'o skol la cis kyang byar med cig 'tshal/ yang na 'chi ba bsgoms pas cis kyang byar med cig skye dgos/ yang na/ ngo bo la blo nges pas zhen pa rang log ste 'ong*/ thams cad sgyu ma'am rmi lam lta bur shugs kyis mthong ba cig 'ong*/ de yang*/ da lta sgom na/ 'di ltar snang grags kyi chos 'di thams cad ye yod ma myong bar sangs rgyas kyis gsungs/ yod ma myong ba yin yang yin te/ da ltar snang ba 'char ba 'di sus khegs/ las snang ba 'char ba 'di mi khegs gsung*/ sems dang nam mkha' gnyis 'dra ba la/ nam mkha' la rig pa med pas dper 'ong ba yin/ rig pa yod na don rang yin te/ da lta rig pa rgyun chad med pa la/ bden pa mthong nas ye shes rgyun chad med pa bya bar ming btags/ gsang sngags pa ni lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bya bar da lta rang nas bdog gsung*/ ngo bo ni byin rlabs rang las bsgoms pas mi 'ong*/ bsgom rgyu yang med/ yi dam lha ni ye nas yin/ sgom mi 'tshal/ bsgom rgyu byang chub kyi sems las med pas/ byang chub kyi sems dang ma bral bar sgom 'tshal/ kyai rdo rje las kyang*/ kun rdzob sgyu mas byang chub bsgrub pa nyid// ces gsungs so// spyir chos gsha' mar byed pa la/ yin min dang*/ legs nyes la sogs pa brtsis pas chos (7ba)ga na 'ong*/ de kun gang la yang mi blta bar/ shes pa skad cig ma blta ba lags pas/ 'jig rten pa dang 'dzol le ba cig dgos pa yin/ 'jig rten pas 'phyas se ba cig dgos pa yin/ tshe 'dir mi byed dgu byed kyis 'khor ba dang 'brel pa chod pa ga na 'ong*/ dgongs mdzod gsung*/// /bla ma chen po nā ro pa'i bzhed pas/ ma smin pa smin par byed pa dbang gi lam/ smin pa grol bar byed pa thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis/ de yang gdan thog gcig tu bsgom par bya ba dang*/ rim gyis pa'i lugs gnyis yin te/ gdan thog gcig tu sgom pa dus gcig tu ston/

rim gyis pa ni/ 'og ma 'og ma la brtan pa thob nas gong ma gong ma ston te/ bskyed rim la brtan pa thob nas rdzogs rim sgom/ de yang*/ nang nas shar ba de rdzogs rim gsha' ma de yin/ nang nas ma shar na zab pa'i rdzogs rim du ming btags kyang*/ don la blos byas cig yin gsung*/ spyir de ltar yin yang*/ 'khor ba mtha' dag las thar bar byed pa la/ don dam byang chub kyi sems cig rgyud la skye dgos te/ de yang*/ jo bo rje'i lugs kyis phyi nas gcod par bzhed/ bla ma'i bzhed pas nang nas gcod par bzhed/ mtshan nyid pa ni/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa nas mas yar spong bar 'dod pa yin/ bla ma ni shes bya'i sgrib pa nas rtsad der gcod/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa chos kyi sku zhes bya ste/ bla ma'i bzhed pas/ rig pa dang stong pa lhan cig skyes gsung*/ de yang*/ grub pa thob pa'i grub skor nas bshad pa dang*/ bram ze chen po dang*/ klu sgrub la sogs kyi snying po skor du bshad pa dang*/ rdo rje (8na)'chang gi rgyud kyi bshad pa dang*/ rnal 'byor pa la nang nas shar ba ste de rnams yo mthun gsung*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ ma mthun na yang na rang nor/ yang na gzhan nor ba yin gsung*/ jo bo rje'i bka' brgyud kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ dgyes pa rdo rje 'dul ba'i le'u dang bstun nas rim gyis par bzhed pa yin gsung ngo*// bla ma'i zhal nas gcig car ba'i gang zag ni shin tu dkon/ nga ni rim gyi par 'dod pa yin/ gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na yang*/ bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyis/ dang po rdzogs par mi ston/ dang po tshogs gsog tsam du ston/ de nas bskyed rim tsam du ston/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' gzhug pa ston/ de nas dbang bskur/ de nas bdud rtsi myang ba/ de nas mchod bstod/ de nas rdzogs rim ston pa yin te/ de ltar rim gyis ston/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen lcags ri ba'i zhal nas/ lta ba kun rdzob yin mtha' gnyis dang bral ba'i dbu ma bya ba/

pha rol tu phyin pa'i lta ba yin/ don dam pa la blta rgyu med gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi lta ba ni sems yin gsung ngo*/// /rin po che'i zhal nas/ yang tshan cig na re/ snying rje rnam pa gsum stan thog gcig tu sgom du btub zer/ tshan cig na re/ blos rim par 'jog zer te/ don la sbyar na de 'thad par 'dug /sa dang po yan chad kyi byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sangs rgyas gnyis la/ sems can gyi don byed pa la 'ol che chung 'dra bar bzhed pa yang yod de/ sangs rgyas che ba yin/ 'o na sangs rgyas la dgos pa ci yod gsung*/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen la/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems mnga' ba dang*/ don dam byang (8ba)chub kyi sems mnga' ba gnyis/ slob ma la sogs pa la byin rlabs khyad cher bshad pa yang yod de/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems cig yod na/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems mi 'ong mi srid gsung*/ yang don dam byang chub kyi sems rnal ma zhig rgyud la yod na/ dper na/ nor bu rin po che la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ sems can gyi dgos 'dod 'byung ba ltar/ don dam pa byang chub kyi sems la rtog pa mi mnga' yang*/ byin rlabs shugs kyis 'byung ba de chos nyid lags/ zhes gsung ngo*// brtson 'grus stobs kyis 'gro ba bya ba ni/ tshe 'di la brtson 'grus 'bar ba'i stobs kyis sgrub pa la 'gro ba yin te/ des kyang bag mi 'ong*/ rnam smin brgyud nas 'gro ba bya ba yin gsung*/ theg chen gsang sngags ni/ tshe gcig lus gcig gis 'gro ba bya ba yin te/ de yang*/ byin rlabs kyis 'gro ba bya ba yin gsung*/ bla ma rtogs ldan cig dang slob ma skal ldan cig phrad nas/ des gdams ngag rnal ma zhig btab ste/ dben pa'i gnas su phyin nas bsgrubs na/ lus sems bde ba dang*/ 'byung ba ro snyoms pa 'ong ba yin/ sems rtse gcig tu gnas te/ sems la dbang thob pa lta bu yang 'ong ba yin/

btang na btang dbang yod/ bzhag na bzhag dbang yod pa 'ong ba yin/ chos thams cad gting nas go ba lta bu zhig 'ong*/ nga rang 'di las lhag pa cig yar bskyal rgyu med snyam pa 'ong*/ gsang sngags kyi rten 'brel gyis mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad kyis kyang de la grogs byed pa yin/ gzhan thams cad la yang bsgoms na rung snyam pa'i nyams 'byung ba yin gsung*/ bla ma la dad gus chen po skye ba yin/ theg pa chen po'i chos (9na)la yang yid ches skye ba yin/ lar bla ma'i byin rlabs cig ma zhugs na phugs 'khyol pa mi 'ong gsung*/ tshe 'di la blo log pa zhig gis dben pa'i gnas su phyin nas bla ma'i gdams ngag la 'jug pa yin te/ rtsa 'chun pas 'byung ba ro snyoms/ rlung 'chun pas gsal shing gi rtse la bsgom kyang tsen ne ba 'byung*/ thig le 'chun pas lus las su rung ba/ bde ba/ kha zas 'ju ba 'byung*/ sems 'chun pas nyon mongs mi gos pa 'byung*/ de la nyams su myong ba ni rtse gcig la dbang thob pa yang 'ong*/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byon yang 'di bas yar lhag pa med snyam pa'i yid ches nang nas skye ste/ ngag tu brjod du mi btub/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ 'khor 'das kyi rtsad de gar gcod na/ rig ma rig gnyis su gcod pa yin te/ de yang ngo sprod pa yin/ bla ma rtogs ldan cig gis slob ma skal ldan cig la ngo sprod pa yin gsung*/ de yang*/ tai lo pas/ nā ro pa la

de kho na nyid kyi ye shes de ni rang rig pa ste/ tai lo nga yis ci yang bstan du med// bdag nyid 'dod nas sangs rgyas yin pa la// rnam rtog dbang gis sangs rgyas nyid ma mthong*// rtogs pa'i dus na mthong ba med cing thos pa med// gnyis med rang gis rtogs pa de la phyag rgya che/ gsungs pa yin te/ de yang*/ rig pa ngo shes pa/ rtogs pa/ nyams su myong ba gsum gal che gsung*/ ngo shes pa ni rig pa de ngos bzung med pa/ spros pa dang bral ba/ mi 'gyur ba de la sogs pa ni ngo shes pa'o// rtogs pa ni/ ma rig pa nyid/ rig pa yin par yid ches nas the tshom med par rtogs pa de yin no// nyams su myong ba ni/ zag med kyi bde ba lhan cig skyes pa 'od gsal ba de yin gsung*/ spyir ma rig pa'i (9ba)'khor de dug lnga yin te/ de lta bu'i gang zag de la dug lnga ye shes lngar 'char ba yin pa de sus kyang mi khegs pas/ de lta bu'i gang zag des don grub pa yin/ de lta bu rgyud la skye ba la/ 'o cag bzhin du sa gcig tu dpungs pas 'ong ri ngas skar mi thebs gsung ngo*// ༈ //bla ma rin chen lta bu yi// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// tshe la long med myur du 'chi bas/ 'jig rten gyi chos thams cad la ma chags pa zhig dgos/ rigs drug gar skyes kyang skyid med de sdug bsngal gyi phung por shes pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la ma chags pa zhig dgos/ chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba snying rje yin pas/ dus thams cad du sems can blos mi spong ba zhig dgos/ chos thams cad ma skyes shing skye ba med pas/ gang la yang dngos po dang mtshan mar mi 'dzin pa zhig dgos/ chos de rnams rgyud la skye ba la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la dad pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas/ mchod pa dang gsol ba rgyun mi chad pa zhig dgos gsung*/ yun ring du goms pa'i bag chags mthug pos 'khrul pa'i shes pa sna tshogs su shar ba yang*/ byis pa chung ngu'i dpe dang*/

seng ge phru gu'i dpe dang*/ rab rib can gyi nam mkha'i skra shad kyi dpe la sogs pa'i sgo nas 'khrul pa bcad/ snang ba sems dang tha mi dad pa ni/ chu dang chab rom gyi dpe dang*/ tsan+dan dang dri'i dpe dang*/ gla rtsi dang dri'i dpe la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya/ snang ba chos sku la khyab pa ni/ til la mar gyis khyab pa'i dpe dang*/ dngul rdo la dngul dang*/ 'o ma la mar gyis khyab pa'i dpe la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya/ med bzhin du snang ba ni/ du ba dang*/ sprin dang*/ khug (10na)rna la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya/ rten cing 'brel ba sna tshogs pa las snang ba ni/ me long gi gzugs brnyan dang*/ chu nang gi zla ba dang*/ nor bu rin po che'i dpe la sogs pa'i sgo nas rtogs par bya/ de ltar chos thams cad gdod ma nas yod ma myong ba la 'khrul pa'i ngor snang ste/ rmi lam ltar rang gi sems kyi gzugs brnyan/ don ma yin pa la don ltar shar bar rtogs par bya/ de bas na/ chos thams cad mi bden pa/ rdzun pa/ bslu ba/ ming tsam/ btags pa tsam/ tha snyad tsam du blta ste/ de lta bu'i kun rdzob de yang*/ sgyu ma ltar mtha' gnyis dang bral bar rtogs par bya/ de ltar don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byas nas rtogs pa thob snyam yang*/ don mi mthong gsung*/ dbang dang byin rlabs kyi sgo nas smin par byas nas/ bla mas thabs lam nyams su len du bcug pas nyams myong 'ong ste/ de yang*/ gsang sngags kyi man ngag rten 'brel tshogs pa las skye zhing*/ bde gsal mi rtog pa zhi ba yid ches 'byung*/ de yang*/ dad pa dang gus pa'i sgo nas yun ring du nyams su blangs pas/ sems dang lus sbyangs pa'i yon tan mang du 'byung*/ srog dhū tir tshud pa'i stobs kyis/ rtags lnga dang phan yon brgyad la sogs pa yon tan gyi rtags mang du 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i lus sems bde ba ci byung yang zhi gnas yin te/ 'on kyang rtags lnga phan yon brgyad po de zhi lhag zung 'brel las kyang 'byung gi

/gnas pa phra mo zin pa'i gnas pa lteng lteng la ni mi 'byung ngo*// de lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin de bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi yin te/ de lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mngon sum gyi bsam gtan (10ba)gyi dga' bde sgom pa yin gsung*/ de yang*/ bla ma sems kyi stong nyid mngon sum du bya ba gcig gis skye med nges su 'jug ste/ ma nges pa snang la ma nges pa zhes bya ste so sor brtags min gyi 'gog par 'gro /thun mong gi lam yin pas gar skye cha med pa yin gsung*/ nges pa'i shes pa skyes na/ rtog pa dang bral ba'i stong nyid mngon sum nyid rab tu shes so// sems skye med kyi ngo bo la ma nges na/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ de de yin te de de min// sdong po yin te 'bras bu min// yon tan yin te rtog med min// zhes gsung ngo*// jo bo rje'i zhal nas kyang*/ nges sbyang bag chags bral bas rnal 'byor ma mthong ba// nam mkha'i me tog bung bas 'jibs pa mthong ba 'dra// zhes gsungs so// des na/ chos thams cad sems kyi rang bzhin yin pas sems kyi chos nyid rtogs na/ chos thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid rtogs pa yin no// des na/ sems kyi rang bzhin gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba chos sku'i ngo bo de/ sangs rgyas byon yang rung ma byon yang rung ste/ rang bzhin gnas pas na rtag ces bya'o// de yang*/ rnam par rtog pa rnam spangs pa// gzung dang 'dzin pa dang bral ba// ye shes 'dus ma byas pa ste// rgyu dang rkyen gyis ma bskyed pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i sems kyi chos nyid rtogs pa ni/ zag pa med pa'i sdom pa sa dang po'i mngon sum yin te/ sems kyi stong nyid la nges shes skyes pa'i phyir ro// nges shes ji ltar skyes na/ gzugs brnyan dang sgyu ma yul gyi stong nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa ltar/ sems sgyu ma dang chu zla bzhin du rang nyid la nges shes 'dren no// de ltar sems kyi stong nyid la nges shes thob pa la tshad ma (11na)zhes bya'o// de yang*/

rang rig rtog pa med pa yis// stong nyid mngon sum nges gyur pa// bde chen rtog pa med pa dang*// khyad par med par skal mnyam mthong*// zhes gsungs so// nang gi sems nyid kyi stong nyid mthong ba'i shugs kyis/ phyi'i yul stong par rtogs pa ni rnal 'byor gyi mngon sum yin/ de yang dang po shes pa ngos zin na de nyid yin te/ shes rab mig gis sems la legs par bltas pas/ sems kyi ngo bo thog mtha' med de nam mkha' 'dra// dbus kyang med de ci yang min pa'i phyir// de yang ngo bo bdag gis smra bar mi nus so// zhes gsungs te/ tha mal gyi shes pa'i ngo bo de la bsgom bya sgom byed kyi gnyis 'dzin gyi bsam gtan dang bral bas/ sgom du med pa sgom pa'i mchog /ces gsungs so// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems kyi ngo bo stong nyid mngon sum du mthong ba de la chos sku zhes bya ste/ de yang*/ zla ba tshes pa dang*/ seng ge phru gu dang*/ byis pa chung ngu'i dpes rtogs par bya'o// de yang*/ ma bcos par bzhag pas nyams su myong ste/ myong ba'i don la yang dang yang du nges pa thob par bya/ yun ring du gnas shing mi 'gyur ba la yon tan du mi blta ste/ 'ching ba'i bsam gtan du 'gro gsung*/ rang bzhin gyi ngo bo ni sems ma bcos pa kho na yin no// 'di'i don nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob pa ni/ skye 'jigs dang bral ba dang*/ dus thams cad pa dang*/ rgyun chad med pa dang*/ mi 'gyur ba dang*/ thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ don de rnams nyams su myong zhing rtogs pa thob na/ don dam mthong ba yin te/ da ni bdag gis su la'ang dri bar mi bya'o// zhes (11ba)gsungs so// de yang*/ dang por dmigs pa dang rtsol bas mi sgrub/ bar du mi gnas/ tha mar snyems byed kyi rtog pa dang bral bar bya/ dus thams cad du dran pa rgyun chags kyi ting nge 'dzin dang mi 'bral bar bya/ lhan cig skyes pa'i nyams dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas/

zag med kyi bde ba rgyun chad med pas lus sems la rlan phab ste/ sbyangs pa'i yon tan thob par bya/ byams snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dang ma bral bas/ thabs shes zung 'jug tu rtogs pas sgrub pa'o// bla ma dam pa rnams kyi gdams ngag /rang gis bsgoms pa'i nyams myong*/ dad 'dun gyi gang zag rnams la skye bar gyur cig// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ bskyed rim la brtan pa chung ngu thob pa ni/ rang nyid lhar mthong ba ste/ phung po lnga po rnam snang la sogs pa rigs lnga'i rang bzhin du shes/ de nyid kyis bdag kyang he ru ka'i rang bzhin du mthong nas/ rang tha mal pa'i 'du shes log pa'o// brtan pa 'bring thob pa ni/ rang nyid ci 'dra ba de 'dra bar sems can thams cad mthong ba'o// brtan pa cher thob pa ni/ rang gzhan gnyis kyang sgyu ma lta bu/ rmi lam lta bu/ 'ja' tshon lta bur mthong ba'o/// /rdzogs rim rdzogs rim la brtan pa thob pa'i drod rtags phyi nang gsang gsum du 'byung bas/ la brtan pa thob pa ni/ phyi'i drod lus yod par mi tshor/ nang gi drod dbugs 'gyu ba mi tshor/ gsang ba'i drod sems nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bur rtogs pa 'byung gsung*/// /yang rin po che'i zhal nas/ spyir thos pa'i shes rab kyis chos thams cad go yul du byed/ bsam pa'i shes rab (12na)kyis chos 'byed par byed de/ theg pa che chung 'byed pa dang*/ lta ba dang lta ba ma yin pa 'byed par byed/ sgom pa'i shes rab kyis sems glang po che smyon pa dang 'dra ba de/ dmigs pa'i ka ba la dran pa'i zhags thag gis dam du bcings nas blo rtse gcig tu 'jog pa de zhi gnas yin te/ bde gsal mi rtog pa'i nyams byung yang*/ sems nyid du ma chod na snang la ma nges pa zhes bya/ de rang bzhin ma grub pa skye med du rtogs pa ni lhag mthong zhes bya/ ji srid blo'i rtog dpyod yod phan chad ni/

bsam pa'i shes rab la/ rtog dpyod las 'das nas sgom pa'i shes rab ces bya'o// de ltar lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyangs pas/ tshogs lam du mos pa tsam zhig yul du byed/ drod rtse mo la sogs pa sbyor lam du gzugs brnyan tsam zhig yul du byed/ mthong lam gyis ye shes mthong spang spangs nas de kho na nyid kyi don mngon sum du byed/ sgom lam gyis ye shes su shes bya'i sgrib pa mtha' dag spangs nas/ sa bcu rgyun mtha' la rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin bar chad med pa'i lam las/ srid pa'i sa bon rnam par shes pa 'gags nas/ chos kyi sku bde ba chen po mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// zhes gsung ngo*// pha rol tu phyin pa lam gyi gzhung shing lta bu cig yin gsung*/ gsang sngags kyi dbang du byas na/ ma smin pa smin par byas nas smin pa grol bar byed pa thabs bskyed rdzogs gnyis la brten nas/ rdzogs rim spros bcas dang spros med la brten nas/ rang rig pa'i ye shes 'od gsal rgyun chad med pa nyams su myong bar byed do// zhes gsung ngo*/ de ltar pha rol tu phyin pa don spyi'i rnam pa bstan la/ gsang sngags su don dngos bstan pa ci ste zhe na/ 'jam (12ba)dpal gyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol pa/ gsang sngags su don dngos bstan la/ pha rol tu phyin par ci'i phyir don dngos mi ston pa lags/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal/ 'dul ba ni ba lta bu'o// mdo sde ni 'o ma lta bu'o// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni zho lta bu'o// gsang sngags ni mar lta bu'o// gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das/ pha rol tu phyin par don spyi'i rnam pa bstan la/ gsang sngags su don dngos bstan pa ci ste/ bka' stsal pa/ 'jam dpal/ chu bre gsum gyi nang du mar bre gang sdus nas/ chu bre gsum po skams nas/ mar bre gang lus pa ni mar gyi nying khu zhes bya'o// de bzhin du/ sde snod rnams kyi nang nas/ gsang sngags ni mar gyi nying khu lta bu'o// zhes gsungs so// gsang sngags ni rang rig pa'i ye shes rang la rtogs pa'i phyir don dngos bstan to/// /yang rin po che'i zhal nas/

phyag rgya chen po don gsum pa ni/ sems nyid lhan cig skyes pa zhes bya/ rang gi sems gdod nas lhun gyis grub pa/ 'dus ma byas/ skye 'gag med pa/ stong la gsal ba/ bde la ngos bzung med par shes dgos/ de rtogs na lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bya ba lags gsung*/ rang la ye nas yod pa de shes na ye shes bya ba yin/ sa dang po'i bden pa bya ba yin/ rtse gcig bya ba yin/ sems ngo shes pa bya ba yin/ de rang gi brtson 'grus dang*/ 'dus byas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsag pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus drag pos rtogs pa yin gsung*/ rang yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms la/ bla ma nyin mo spyi bor bsgom/ nub mo snying pad ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bsgom/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams (13na)cad dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams spyi bor yang yang bsgom zhing rang la stim/ yid la gang yang mi bya bar bzhag pa'o// de ltar yang yid la ma byed mi dmigs zhog /ces gsungs so// snang ba lhan cig skyes pa ni/ chu zla'am me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar/ snang yang gzung du med 'dzin du yang med pa bzhin du/ rang gi sems kyi snang ba 'dzin pa yin la/ lus sems rtsa ba bral bas/ rnam rtog rtsa bral du shes par bya'o// bu chung ngam/ smyon pa ltar zhen chags med par bzhag go /rnam rtog byung yang sems su shes par byas la 'gro nyal 'dug sdod thams cad la goms par bya ste sgom zhing*/ res 'ga' rtsa rlung bsgoms pas bogs che ba lags gsung skad/ de ni snang ba lhan cig skyes pa'am/ snang stong dbyer med dam/ zung 'jug gi rnal 'byor ram/ spros bral gyi gang zag bya ba yin/ chab rom chur zhu ba dang 'dra/ 'khor ba la 'jigs mi dgos gsung*/ phyag rgya chen po don gsum pa'o/// /rtogs ldan rin po che la 'dud/ tshe 'di spangs nas nyams su len pa zhig la/ chos spang blang gnyis yin/ de la rgyu rkyen/ bdag po'i rkyen/

dmigs pa'i rkyen/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen dang bzhi las/ spang bya ni/ rgyu'i dus na dngos po med pa zhig yin pa la/ dngos po dang mtshan mar bzung bas zhen nas/ bdag po'i rkyen gyi dus su/ log pa'i bshes gnyen gyis/ tshig dang tha snyad du 'byams pa la sogs pas/ dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi dus su 'khrul te/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dus na re dwogs su song na ni 'khor bar ltung ste spang bya'o// blang bya ni/ rgyu'i rkyen gyi dus na ma zhen cing zhen (13ba)pa log pa cig la/ bdag po'i rkyen gyi dus na/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen dang phrad nas dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi dus su ma 'khrul pas/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dus na/ re dwogs dang bral ba ni sangs rgyas pa ste/ blang bya'o// de la/ yang dag pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni bzhi ste/ gang zag dang*/ bka' dang*/ snang ba dang*/ rig pa'o/ de yang*/ gang zag la brten nas gzhan gsum po 'char bas/ gang zag gi mtshan nyid ni/ gsol 'debs nus pa/ 'gal sgyur nus pa/ ma 'khrul ba/ shes rab kyis 'byed nus pa'o// de yang*/ rnam rtog sku drin can du shes nas/ gang byung shes rab kyi grogs su sgyur ba ni/ gsol 'debs nus pa'o// ma bde ba rang gi rgyud la gzan nges pa cig byung yang*/ de la mi bzod med par/ slar grogs su 'gro na 'gal sgyur nus pa'o// 'khrul pa thams cad rnam rtog ngo ma shes pas 'khrul te/ rnam rtog sems su shes pas rtog pa lam du byed pa ni ma 'khrul pa'o// rnam rtog de ltar du shes na/ mdung nam mkha' la bskor ba bzhin du/ chos thams cad la thogs rdugs med pa ni shes rab kyis go 'byed nus pa'o// dmigs pa'i rkyen la bzhi ste/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// shes pa'i mtshan nyid la/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid ngo shes par byas la/ skye ba med pa chos sku/

'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul sku/ sku gsum rtog pa'i blo la yang snang*/ tshig tu brjod du 'dod kyang ngo bo la ngos bzung dang bral ba blo'i yul las 'das pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku'o// sems kyi mtshan (14na)nyid sku bzhi ngos 'dzin pas/ shes pa'i mtshan nyid yin/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa byung tshad sems nyid yin pas mi spong bar sku bzhir 'khyer ba'o// byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa sku bzhi yin yang byed pa med/ chos sku sgyu ma lta bur 'gro ba'o// ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gdod ma nas sku bzhi lhun gyis grub pa de yin/ de ltar chos thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi las ma 'das pa de lta bu'i go cha ste/ thams cad shes rab kyi yul du shes pas/ mtha' thams cad khegs nas/ dper na/ bya thag pas btags pa dang 'dra'o// shes rab kyi go cha ni/ rdo rje skyil krung bcas/ lus bsrang*/ mig sna rtser phab/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas la/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid la bltas pas/ tshig tu lan gsum brjod pa ni thos pa'i shes rab/ tshig de la brten nas don go bar byed pa ni bsam pa'i shes rab/ rtog pa don du shes pa ni sgom pa'i shes rab bo// de ni dmigs pa'i rkyen gyi dus na ma 'khrul ba'o// de ma thag pa'i rkyen ni/ shes rab kyis de ltar nyams su blangs pas/ rtogs pa mngon gyur gyi sangs rgyas shes kyang de la bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba'i dbang du byas na/ de lta bu'i don rtogs cing khong du chud pa ni/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin/ chos thams cad de nyid yin pas/ rtog pa nyid la lam byed pa ni chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ de ltar rtog pa lam du byed pa'i mkhan po rten med pa'i rig pa las byung bas/ thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dge 'dun yin/ de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi lam de la/ rtog pa ci skyes thams cad pha rol tu phyin pa drug gi lam du 'gro/

(14ba)thabs su 'gro/ rtog pa ci skyes nyid kyi skul mar btab nas grogs su 'gro ste/ rtog pa gang dang gang gi mtshan nyid shes pas shes rab/ rtog pa thams cad lam du byung bas bsam gtan/ rtog pa skyes tshad lam nyid du skyes pas/ yongs su sbyong ba'i brtson 'grus/ chos nyid kyi don la mi skrag pas bzod pa/ de lta bu'i bsam gtan de la nyon mongs pa'i sa bon med pas tshul khrims/ de lta bu'i thabs shes kyis rten 'brel lam tu blangs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes nas ci byas sems can gyi don du 'gro bas sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o// de lta bu dang ldan pa'i lam 'di skabs brgyad da ltar gyi sgrub pa po'i lag char khyer bas phyir mi ldog pa thob ste/ sems dang rtog pa tha mi dad de thams cad sku bzhir khyer bas rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad lam du shes pas lam shes/ sgrub pa po thams mkhas nas byas pa ma yin par/ gdod ma nas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid de/ de ltar yin par shes pas gzhi shes/ rgyu lam 'bras bu gsum ngo bo gcig tu sbyor bas/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs/ de ltar shes pas shes rab rno zhing rtsal sbyong ba la tshegs med pas rtse mo/ de ltar rtog pa mi spong bar mthar gyis sgrub pas mthar gyis pa/ shes rab kyis gnas skabs kyi mtshan nyid shes pas skad cig ma la byang chub pa/ thams cad chos sku'i 'phrin las yongs su longs spyod pas sku yongs su rdzogs pa'o// khyad par gyis lam 'di la/ lam rnam pa lnga'i dbang du byas na/ rtog pa dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas tshogs lam/ rtog pa nyid la brten nas lam khyad par can rgyud la (15na)skyes pas na sbyor lam/ rtog pa nyid sku bzhir mthong bas/ mthong lam/ rtog pa gang skyes kyang sku bzhi dang mi 'bral bas/ sgom lam/ de nyid la nges shes skyes nas/ de las lhag pa'i lam gzhan la bslab tu med pas/

mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// lam de nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du 'gro ste/ dran pa byung tshad lam du 'gro bas na/ dran pa nye bar bzhag pa/ rtog pa mi spong bar/ shes rab kyis rtog pa'i mtshan nyid shes pas/ de nyid yang dag par spong ba/ lam de la rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'byung bas/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dad pas rgyu byas/ dran pas lam byas/ brtson 'grus kyis grogs byas/ de gsum ni thabs yin te/ de gsum de ltar shes pas/ shes rab/ thabs shes rab kyi rten 'brel bskrun pas thams cad ting nge 'dzin du 'byung bas 'bras bu/ de ltar dbang po lnga lag tu blangs pas shes rab kyi rtsal dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa la tshegs med pas/ stobs lnga/ de ltar thabs shes kyi rten 'brel bskul bas shes rab kyi rtsal sbyangs pa de la byang chub kyi sems skyes pas/ dran rig thams cad byang chub kyi grogs su 'byung bas byang chub kyi yan lag go /thams cad byang chub yan lag tu shes pas rnam rtog longs spyod kyang*/ rnam rtog nyid kyis mi gos par de nyid lam du 'gro bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o// de ltar lta ba'i go cha ni/ chos thams cad kyi brdar sha bcad nas/ gol sa thams cad kyi mtha' kheg pa las/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen gyi dus na re dwogs dang bral bar 'gro'o// de la yang*/ shes (15ba)rab kyi go chas rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba'i dus su/ gong du bstan pa'i lam gyi yon tan la/ shes rab kyis bsngo bgrang byed dam zhe na/ de ltar byas na/ skyon du 'gro ste/ lam ni/ sgom pa'i shes rab 'ba' zhig la byed pa yin/ sgom pa'i shes rab ni tshig dang blo las 'das pa yin/ 'o na lam du ji ltar 'khyer na/ dran pas lam du 'khyer te/ gang la brten nas 'khyer na/ rtog pa nyid la brten nas shes rab kyis dran pa la dbang bsgyur cing 'gro ba'o// rtog pa la ji ltar blta na/

rtog pa rim gyis 'byung dus su/ de yang spang blo mi btang bar/ snying du sdug pa/ dgos pa/ sku drin can du blta/ de ltar blta ba ci zhe na/ yon tan thams cad rang la rang chas su yod pas/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtogs pa yin pas/ de ltar bltas pas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid ngo shes pas sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyis 'byung*/ de ltar rtog pa lam du khyer bas ma zhi bar chags sdang skyes na/ rtog pa gcig skyes na ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas myur du mi spang bar gong gi lta bas gtan la dbab/ de ltar rtogs nas rang zhi rang grol du song bas/ yon tan gyi chos su gyur pa thams cad 'gag pa med par shugs kyis 'byung ste/ yon tan de lta zhes na/ lam brdungs te/ de la yang mi gnas par/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bur shes par byas la/ gong du shes rab kyi rtsal sbyang ngo*// de ltar shes rab kyi rtsal gyis rtog pa chos skur mthong bas tshad ma zhes de la bya/ shes rab kyis rtog pa'i rtsa ba ngo shes pas/ mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbu ma'o// gol sa gcod pa*/// /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sems tsam pa rang rig don dam (16na)du 'dod de/ rig pa'i ye shes rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la gsal ba'i rang rig don dam du yod par 'dod/ dbu ma pa na re/ khyod kyi don dam pa gang yin pa/ de ni nga yi kun rdzob yin/ khyod kyi a ma gang yin pa/ de ni nga yi chung ma yin/ khyod kyi rang rig don dam par yod par bzung ba de ngar 'dzin yin te/ de ni nga yi kun rdzob yin/ nga ni yod pa'i mtha' dang bral/ med pa'i mtha' dang bral/ gnyis ka'i mtha' dang bral/ gnyis ka ma yin pa'i mtha' dang bral/ mtha' bzhi dang bral bas gang yang khas mi len/ pha rol tu phyin pa na re/ khyod rang khas gang yang mi len na/ sems tsam pa la sogs pa'i grub mtha' gzhan khegs sam mi khegs zhes zer/ dbu ma pa na re/ khegs zer/ phar phyin pa na re/

khyod kyi khas gang yang ma blangs kyang*/ grub mtha' gzhan khegs pa'i phyir khas blangs su thal/ nga ni gang du yang mi dmigs te/ shes pa 'das pa ni 'gags te/ dper yang mi rung*/ rgyur yang mi rung*/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes te/ dper yang mi rung*/ rgyur yang mi rung*/ da ltar gyi shes pa skad cig ma 'di brtag dka' ste/ mtshan nyid med pa/ ma skyes pa/ ma 'gags pa'o// de bas na/ gzugs dang*/ tshor ba la sogs pa mi dmigs pas na/ nga ni gang du yang mi dmigs pa'o// gsang sngags pa na re/ khyed thams cad dang nga mthun/ sems tsam pa dang mthun te/ rang rig pa'i ye shes rtog ge'i yul las 'das pa/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la gsal ba dang mthun/ khyod bas nga lhag ste/ khyod rang rig don dam pa yod par 'dod/ (16ba)nga rig pa skye med yin/ dbu ma pa dang mthun te/ mtha' bzhi'am/ brgyad dang yang bral bar 'dod pas mthun/ khyod bas nga lhag ste/ khyod nyams myong mi 'dod de/ nyams myong yod pas nga lhag /dbu ma pa na re/ khyod nyams myong 'dod pas mi rung*/ nyams rtog pa yin/ rtog pa 'khor ba yin/ nga nyams myong mi 'dod zer/ gsang sngags pa na re/ khyod sgom mam mi sgom/ sgom na nyams myong mi 'byung mi srid/ mi sgom na nyams myong med/ nyams myong med na sangs mi rgya/ rang rig pa skye med blo las 'das pa'i nyams de/ khyod kyis smra bar mi nus so// pha rol tu phyin pa dang mthun/ phyi gzung ba'i yul de sems kyi rnam 'phrul yin pas/ gzhi rtsa ma grub pa gang du yang mi dmigs pa dang mthun/ khyod bas nga lhag /khyod shes pa 'das pa ni 'gags te/ dper yang mi rung*/ rgyur yang mi rung*/ ma 'ongs pa ni ma skyes te/ dper mi rung*/ rgyur yang mi rung*/ da ltar gyi shes pa skad cig ma 'di brtag dka' ste/ skad cig ma de ka ltar khyer bas khyod la thug pa med pa'i skyon yod/ khyod don spyi'i rnam pa yul du byas pa yin/ rang nyid stong par ma shes pas/

yul dang stong pa mi skye ste rjes dpag la rgyas 'debs med/ sgro 'dogs re re gcod pa'i phyir ro// nga la rgyas 'debs yod/ nga phyi gzung ba'i yul la brtag dpyad mi gtong*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems 'di dang po skye ma myong*/ tha ma 'gags mi srid/ skye 'gag med pa'i ngo bo'i nyams de dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas kyis gcod par mi nus/ de lta bu'i nyams myong yod pas nga lhag /'o na gsang sngags pa rang la gnyis te/ thabs dang shes rab bo// thabs ni gtum mo// gtum (17na)mo'i yon tan ni/ rlung khong du chud pas rtags lnga dang*/ yon tan brgyad 'byung ste/ rtags lnga ni/ du ba lta bu dang*/ smig rgyu lta bu dang*/ srin bu me khyer lta bu dang*/ mar me lta bu dang*/ sprin med pa'i nam mkha' lta bu'o// phan yon brgyad ni/ sa yis lus gzung thub/ chu yis snum/ me yis drod skye/ rlung gis yang zhing g.yo/ nam mkhas yod par mi tshor/ zla bas mdangs gsal/ nyi mas gzhan gyis mi mthong*/ thams cad kun son po'i phan yon ci la yang thogs rdugs med pa'o// nyon mongs pa ni/ gzung 'dzin gnyis rlung la 'gyu ste/ rlung dhū tir tshud na nyon mongs pa ngang gis 'gag /de bzhin du/ yi dwags kyang rlung gnyis nas 'jug ste/ rlung dhū tir tshud na yi dwags kyis mi tshugs/ de bzhin du 'byung bzhi'i nad kyis kyang mi tshugs so// de la sogs pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab bo// shes rab ni/ skye ba med pa'i rig pa/ 'gag pa med pa'i lam/ gnas pa med pa'i shes rab ste/ thob pa med pa'i 'bras bu gsum gyis phul te/ skye ba med pa'i rig pa/ chos gdod ma nas ma skyes shing skye ba med par thag chod/ skye med gcig pur byas na chad ltar 'gro ste/ skye med la rig pa khong rkyal du gnas pa ni/ dper na/ 'o ma la mar yod pa dang 'dra'o// 'gag pa med pa'i lam ni/ gsal ba'am nyams su myong rgyu cig med na lam du mi 'gro ste/

rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ gsal la go ma 'gag pa/ de la goms par byed pa lam mo// gnas pa med pa'i shes rab ni/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad chad pas na shes rab ces bya'o// mi mthun pa ni/ dngos po dang mtshan ma la sogs pa yin (17ba)no// rig pa'i ngo bo rtogs na/ mar me byung bas mun pa 'bros pa bzhin/ mi mthun pa shugs kyis gcod pas na shes rab bo// thob pa med pa'i 'bras bu ni/ mi mthun pa rnams chad par gyur ba'i ngo bo de las chos sku 'byung*/ de las gzugs sku 'byung ba ni thob pa med pa'i 'bras bu'o/// /bla ma dam pa rnam la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrib pa ni gsum ste/ shes bya'i sgrib pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa/ las kyi sgrib pa'o// de ngos 'dzin na/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ni don la ma rig pa yin/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/ ye nas rgyud la yod pa'i 'dod chags la sogs pa'o// de'i rtsa ba ma rig pa las byung*/ las kyi sgrib pa ni/ nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs pa'i mi dge ba bcu spyad pas/ 'bras bu sdug bsngal 'byung ba de yin te/ de gsum spong ba ni/ bka' gdams la sogs pa dge bshes kun ni/ sngon la gnyis po sbyangs la/ shes bya zhor la sbyang gsung*/ bla ma mi la'i zhal nas/ sngon la shes bya sbyang*/ shes bya 'byongs nas las nyon gnyis po sgrog rang brdal/ shes bya ma 'byongs na las nyon gnyis po lan cig 'byongs kyang*/ yang skye/ dper na/ sdong po'i yal ga bcad pa dang 'dra/ shes bya la 'byongs na/ sdong po'i rtsa ba nas bcad pa dang 'dra/ skye rgyu med de sgrog rang brdal song ba yin gsung*/ de gnyis ka bden/ dge bshes pa bden te/ las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis dang ma bral na sangs rgya ba'i thabs med/ bla ma bden te/ shes bya la ko long ma gsol na/ las nyon gnyis zad kyang ma phan/ shes sgrib la/ so so'i skye bo'i dus bag la nyal zhes bya ste/ chu dang 'o ma bzhin du rgyud dang 'dres pas/

yul dang phrad na snang gis/ rnam (18na)smin 'phral du mi 'byin/ bag chags de la/ rnam shes zhes bya ste/ mdo las/ len pa'i rnam par shes pa zab cing phra// sa bon thams cad chu bo'i rgyun bzhin 'bab// bdag tu rtog par gyur na mi rung zhes// byis pa'i skye bo rnams la ngas ma bstan// zhes gsungs pas/ zab pa ni/ gting ma rnyed pa la bya/ phra ba ni mi mthong ba'o// de la/ bag chags kyi sa bon 'debs pa ni dper na/ rang gi byad bzhin la tshon rtsi dkar nag gnyis byugs nas/ me long la bltas pas gzugs brnyan pha gir shar ba de/ byad bzhin gyi de phar 'phos sam zhe na ma 'phos/ de med pa yang ma byung*/ de bzhin du/ rnam shes la bag chags kyi sa bon btab pas/ yul dang phrad pa'i dus su/ 'bras bu pha gir snang ba de/ rnam shes de phar 'phos sam zhe na/ ma 'phos/ rnam shes las g.yos pa med de/ de med par yang ma byung*/ rnam shes de ma 'gags shing gsal bas na rnam shes zhes bya'o// de'i ngo bo ni sems yin te/ ye shes yin/ rgyud dag pa'i rang bzhin yin pas/ cir snang rang gi ngo bor shar bas sa bon gdab bya 'debs byed med mod/ sa dang po'i bden pa mthong nas ming du shes bya'i sgrib par btags/ de spong ba ni/ bsgoms pas spong ba las gzhan gyis mi spong*/ de spong ba'i dpe ni/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsi dang 'dra ste/ lcags la ye nas gser gyi rang bzhin yod pa la/ bzo bos rtsi byugs pas/ lcags je chung du 'gro/ gser je che la mthar gser gyi rang bzhin du 'gyur/ de bzhin du/ shes pa la ye shes kyi rang bzhin ye nas yod pa la/ bla ma'i man ngag gis mtshon nas/ shes bya je 'gags la/ (18ba)ye shes je gsal la song nas/ mthar rgyud dge ba'i rang bzhin du 'gyur/ de yang*/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i 'dod pas ni/ mthong lam gyis ji ltar mthong ba'i don de/ sa bcu'i bar du goms par byas pa las/ sa bcu rgyun mtha' rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la brten nas/

las kyi sgrib pa'i sa bon rnam par shes pa 'gags nas/ skad cig ma gnyis pa la bde ba chen po chos kyi sku/ dus thams cad du chad pa med pa mngon du gyur pa yin gsung*/ sngags ni/ bsam gtan gyi 'od gsal la goms par byas pas/ bar do dang po'i dus su shes bya 'gags/ rang bzhin 'od gsal la gnas so// der gnas ma nus na da rung shes bya ma 'byongs pa yin gsung*/ nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni/ bslab pa gsum gyis rtsad nas gcod/ las kyi sgrib pa ni/ stobs bzhis 'dag par byed de/ rten gyi stobs bla ma dang dkon mchog la gsol ba 'debs/ sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas kyi sdig pa la 'gyod pa'i sgo nas lus ngag gi dge ba gang byed pa de yin/ gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas pa la 'gyod nas/ phyis spong ba'i sgo nas lus ngag gi dge ba gang byed pa de yin/ sor chud pa'i stobs ni/ sngar byas la 'gyod/ phyis mi byed par khas blangs nas/ mi dge ba bcu spong zhing*/ dge ba bcu dang du len pa de yin no/// /bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di blos btang nas chos gsha' ma byed pa la/ bla ma ma nor ba gcig dang phrad dgos/ chos ma nor ba gcig dang phrad dgos/ bla ma nor ba dang phrad/ chos ma nor ba dang phrad na/ lam ma nor ba rgyud la mi skye/ de ma skyes na 'bras bu ma nor ba rgyud la mi 'char/ de ma shar (19na)na sangs mi rgya/ de bas na/ bla ma ma nor ba gcig dang phrad na/ chos ma nor ba gcig dang yang phrad pas/ lam ma nor ba rgyud la skye/ de skyes na 'bras bu ma nor ba rgyud la 'char gsung*/ chos gsha' ma zhig byed na/ dang po mi rtag pa bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ tshe 'di la blo log pa zhig dgos/ de nas/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba mtha' dag la blo ldog dgos/ de nas/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba na gnas pa'i ma rnams kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i blo skye dgos/

byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis rgyud la skyes na sangs rgya/ de gnyis ma skyes na sangs mi rgya/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa dang*/ bskyed rim sgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa byed pa la sogs pa yang*/ de gnyis kyis zhabs tog gi tshul du byed pa yin/ yang na/ bsod nams kyi tshogs ma grub kyang*/ de gnyis rang bsod nams kyi tshogs yin/ kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du/ byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dang mi 'bral gsung*/// /bsgom par bya ba ni/ phyi gzung ba'i yul dang*/ nang 'dzin pa'i sems

gzung ba'i yul 'di dag ni/ sems las byung ba yin/ sems kyis ma bskyed pa'i dngos po gang yang med/ gnyis yin te/ phyi gzung ba'i yul ni/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor nas/ srid pa'i rtse mo'i bar 'di dag ni brdzun pa yin te/ dang po nas yod ma myong ba yin/ dper na/ rmi lam rmis pa'i dus su zas skom la longs spyad pa la sogs pa rmi ste/ gnyis sad pa'i dus su gang la yang ma grub/ dpe de bzhin du/ da lta 'khor ba'i chos sna tshogs su snang yang*/ bden pa mthong ba'i dus su gang (19ba)yang ma grub ste/ de ltar bden par mthong yang brdzun pa yin/ brdzun pa'i ngos nas bden pa yin te/ snang ba sgyu ma rmi lam tsam du shes par bya'o// nang 'dzin pa'i sems 'di bden pa yin te/ dang po ma skyes/ tha mar mi 'gag /rgyu rkyen gyis ma skyed/ gang du yang 'gyur ba med/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs la mnga' ba dang*/ sems can gyi sems nyid la bzang ngan med/ rtogs ma rtogs kyi khyad par yin/ blos byas kyi stong pas yang dang yang du bsgoms mi rtogs te/ sems kyi ngo bo de mthong ye ma myong ba yin/ sems kyi mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa sna tshogs su 'phro zhing sna tshogs su 'char ba yin/ skyes bu shes rab chung ba ni/ sems dang rtog pa gnyis tha dad du rtogs/ shes rab can ni gnyis med du rtogs te/ rtog pa sems las byung zhing sems la thim/ chu dang chu'i rlabs bzhin/ sems kyi rang bzhin ni 'od gsal ba/ ci'i ngo bor yang ma grub pa yin/ dang po blo gsar pa'i dus su/ dang po gang nas skyes/ gar 'gags/ ji ltar gnas bsam pas blo nges par byed pa yin/ de nyid blo cher song nas/ ma bcos pa'i shes pa rang gsal la 'jog pa yin/ yul de nyid la dad pa/ brtson pa/ gus pas nan tan gyis rgyun ring bsgom par bya ste/ chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rgyun chad med pa dang*// mar me'i rtse mo rlung gis ma bskyod dang*// bu ni yid 'ong bral ba'i ma bzhin du// nyin dang mtshan du 'bad de bsgrub pa na// lo zla 'ga' na don kun thams cad 'grub// ces gsung ngo*/// /yang rin po che sgam po pa'i zhal nas/

nga la blta rgyu sems nyid gcig pu las med/ sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la blo nges shes skyes pa de lta (20na)ba yin/ de nyid gsal bar nyams su myong ba de sgom pa yin/ bya ba ci byed kyang de dang ma bral bar spyod pa de spyod pa yin/ goms par gyur rtsa na 'bras bu lags so// zhes legs par gsungs so// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun kyi sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las kun gyi sras gcig pu// khams gsum 'gro ba'i dpal mgon sgam po pa'i// bka' 'bum dpag bsam ljon shing legs par rdzogs// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ de ltar mtshan yongs su grags pa'i chos kyi rje mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu'i bka' 'bum dpag bsam ljon shing 'gro ba kun gyi re 'dod skong bar byed pa/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dbang gi rgyal po lta bu 'di yi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa ni gsum las/ gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi skor mang du gsungs pa'i brgyud pa ni/ rigs drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po dang*/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma gnyis kyis/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog chen po jo bo tai lo pa la gnang*/ des mkhas pa chen po nā ro pa la gnang*/ des rjes btsun lho brag pa chen po la/ des bla ma chen po mi la ras pa la gnang*/ des mgon po zla 'od gzhon nu la gnang*/ des sangs rgyas sgom pa la gnang*/ khu dbon gnyis kyis/ dpal ldan dus gsum mkhyen pa la gnang*/ des rim pa ltar gsungs pa ni/ 'gro mgon ras chen la/ rgyal sras spom brag pa/ grub chen karma pak+ṣi/ grub thob u rgyan pa/ bla ma snyan ras/ de gnyis kas/ chos rje rang byung rdo rje/ rgyal ba g.yung ston/ rtogs ldan mgon po rgyal mtshan/ de gnyis kas/ chos rje rol pa'i rdo rje/ rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang po/ (20ba)bla ma la phyi ba nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ sgam po pa bla ma rin po che dharma rat+na/ de nyid kyi zhal snga nas dgyes pas gnang ba'o/// /yang lugs gcig la/

rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ sha ba ri dbang phyug /mai trī pa/ mar pa chen po/ mi la ras pa/ dwags po lha rje/// /yang lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ blo gros rin chen/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ ma tang gi pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ snyi sgom/// /yang lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ phyag na rdo rje/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha pa/ lū hi pa/ ḍiṅgi pa/ tai lo pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ chos kyi rje rin po che pa/// /yang lugs gcig la/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka /bir ba pa/ la wa pa/ in+d+ra bo dhi chung ba ste/ bka' babs bzhi'i brgyud pa'o/// /yang lugs gcig la/ rdo rje 'chang*/ su ma ti kun tu bzang mo/ thang lo pa/ kar+ṇa ri pa/ tai lo pa/ nā ro pa/ mar pa/ mi la/ chos kyi rje bsod nams rin chen pa/ tshul khrims snying po/ khams pa dbu se/ 'gro mgon ras pa chen po/ spom brag pa/ karma pa/ u rgyan pa/ snyan ras/ rang byung pa/ rgyal ba g.yung*/ mgon rgyal ba/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ zhwa dmar pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa/ la phyi ba/ bla ma chos rin pa/// /
